note: The attribute rules a character's points are spent by (docs/52-skills.md). Read once when the world starts: restart the world after changing it.

professions.doc: One pair per attribute index 0..50: the profession it belongs to, and whether only a primary of that profession may raise it. Profession 11 marks attributes no player allocates. The client's own table (preforged gw_attributes.h, pinned 2022 VA 980de0).

rank_cost.doc: The total points a rank costs, for ranks 0..12.

level_points.doc: The attribute points a character has at each level, levels 1..20.

max_rank.doc: The highest rank points can buy.

max_attributes.doc: The most attributes one character can have between its two professions: the size of an attribute load.
